en.title: Preliminary Observation: Possible Wetland Loss at Site A
en.summary: A 0.49 ha area where zoning could not be confirmed shows a persistent transition from water-covered to dry or filled surface, first observed in March 2026 and present in 3 of the last 6 months.
evidence: Radar backscatter rose +3.4 dB above the 2023-2024 baseline for the same month
NDWI changed by -0.27 against the same-month baseline
First detected 2026-03, persistent in 3 of 6 recent months

statutory_basis.claim: Synthetic test claim used to check that statutory claims and their citations render correctly.

en.recommended_action: Refer for site inspection and zoning confirmation by the relevant authority.

evidence: 雷達後向散射較 2023 至 2024 年同月基線上升 +3.4 dB
首次偵測於 2026-03，最近 6 個月中持續 3 個月
